title: Meal Planner
description: A responsive weekly meal planner with reusable ingredients, editable grocery lists, recipe details, and repeat-week workflows.
documentation:
# Meal Planner

## Overview
Meal Planner is an offline-first weekly planning tool for organizing breakfast, lunch, and dinner while keeping ingredients, shopping needs, and recipe notes together.

## Features
- **Responsive Weekly Planning**: Scan a seven-day desktop grid or move through a focused mobile carousel
- **Reusable Meal Library**: Select an existing meal to prefill its latest ingredients and instructions
- **Ingredient Tracking**: Save ingredient names, quantities, and units with each planned meal
- **Meal Details**: Review complete ingredient lists and optional preparation instructions from any filled meal card
- **Editable Grocery Lists**: Aggregate matching ingredient names and units for the current week, then check, adjust, remove, or add freeform items without changing source recipes
- **Copy Week**: Merge a meal plan into empty destination slots or replace a destination week while creating independent meal and recipe records
- **Offline Persistence**: Store meals, reusable foods, recipes, and grocery overrides locally with IndexedDB and Dexie.js

## Responsive Experience
Desktop uses a full weekly grid and shadcn dialogs. Mobile switches live to a day carousel and drawer-based workflows at the 768px breakpoint without requiring a reload.

## Technical Implementation
- Next.js and React client components
- TypeScript shared meal, ingredient, grocery, and week-copy models
- Dexie transactions for meal/recipe writes and week copying
- Reusable Food catalog with Recipe junction rows
- Dexie live queries for weekly meals and grocery updates
- Shared meal cards and responsive dialog shell across desktop and mobile

## AI Development Process
The enhanced planner was specified and implemented with GitHub Spec Kit, OpenAI Codex, Claude 3.5, and GitHub Copilot. Spec Kit structured the requirements and phased delivery; AI-assisted implementation supported data modeling, responsive interaction design, debugging, and validation.
